title: OpenPlanning Zoning District Schema v1
description: Defines zoning districts for a jurisdiction. Natural key is {jurisdiction, code}. Code sections reference legal.Block records by section_number, resolved municipality-wide.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction abbreviation, e.g. 'PC'. Resolved within the municipality.

code.description: Short code, e.g. 'C', 'R-20000', 'PEC'. Unique within the jurisdiction.

code_sections.description: Section numbers of legal.Block records that govern this district, e.g. ['180-134', '180-135']. Resolved municipality-wide by section_number.
